description: Return the selected SHVL workspace name, entitlement state, connected accounting organisation name and active Xero agent tenant name.

workspace_id.description: Selected business ID from list_shvl_workspaces. Ask the user to choose if several businesses are available; never infer another business.

name: get_shvl_workspace_status

outputSchema.description: workspace_id and workspace_name identify the selected business; role and entitled describe the caller access. accounting_provider, accounting_organisation_name and xero_tenant_name identify linked accounting context or are null when unavailable. A connection name alone does not prove a fresh sync.

title: Get SHVL workspace status
